scripts.dev: corepack pnpm --filter @graphql/contracts build && corepack pnpm --parallel --filter @graphql/contracts --filter @graphql/web dev
scripts.dev:api: corepack pnpm --filter @graphql/contracts build && corepack pnpm --parallel --filter @graphql/contracts --filter @graphql/api dev
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm --filter @graphql/contracts build && corepack pnpm -r --if-present typecheck
scripts.lint: corepack pnpm --filter @graphql/contracts build && corepack pnpm -r --if-present lint
scripts.test: corepack pnpm --filter @graphql/contracts build && corepack pnpm -r --if-present test
scripts.test:integration: corepack pnpm --filter @graphql/contracts build && corepack pnpm --filter @graphql/api test:integration
scripts.test:acceptance: corepack pnpm --filter @graphql/contracts build && corepack pnpm --filter @graphql/api test:acceptance
